syntheticNotice: SYNTHETIC DEMONSTRATION DATA. All organisations, people, users, addresses and incidents are fictional. This is the smallest valid case bundle and exists to show the required structure.

case.title: Minimal example: intermittent Teams sign-in failures at one site

events.title: Teams sign-in fails for some users
events.body:
Hello,

Since this morning about 20 users at our Leeds office see "We couldn't sign you in" when they start Teams. Users at other offices are not affected.

events.title: Teams sign-in - details needed
events.body:
Hello,

Thank you. Please send the UTC time of one failed sign-in for two affected users and the DNS servers used by the Leeds clients (for example 192.0.2.10).

Regards

events.title: Re: Teams sign-in - details needed
events.body:
Hello,

u1@contoso-synthetic.invalid failed at 08:41 UTC and u2@contoso-synthetic.invalid at 08:44 UTC. The Leeds clients use DNS servers 10.40.1.10 and 10.40.1.11.
